h: Nigerians turn to solar panels as wedding gifts amid power cuts and high petrol prices
p: Some couples are reportedly asking for solar panels as wedding presents because of frequent power outages and the cost of fuel. The trend reflects how households are looking for alternatives to the national grid and petrol generators.
more: The gifts are said to be replacing traditional household items.
Demand for solar equipment has reportedly been rising.
